# title: Retro computer
# background: #08260f
# foreground: #39ff6a
# paper-dim: dim
# color dim: #1f9a40
{dim}**** TINY ENGINEER BASIC V2 ****{/}

# title: ELIZA-style chat
# background: #f2efe4
# foreground: #1d1d1d
# paper-dim: you
# color you: #6b4f2a
HOW DO YOU DO. PLEASE STATE YOUR PROBLEM.
{you}> My robot keeps waving at me.{/}
WHY DO YOU SAY YOUR ROBOT KEEPS WAVING
AT YOU?
{you}> Maybe it wants a coffee.{/}
YOU DON'T SEEM QUITE CERTAIN.
{you}> I am never certain before coffee.{/}
HOW LONG HAVE YOU BEEN NEVER CERTAIN
BEFORE COFFEE?
{you}> Since I started writing firmware.{/}
TELL ME MORE ABOUT WRITING FIRMWARE.
{you}> {/}_

# color dim: #7b8494

{dim}$ explain --to duck src/servos/park.cpp{/}

{duck}          __{/}
        {beak}<{/}{duck}(o )___{/}       So the elbow parks at 0.0

{duck}          `---'{/}

                       ...-0.1. Oh.
                       Never mind. Thanks, duck.

{dim}duck: *squeak*{/}
